route.domain_free_text: banking - unauthorized UPI transaction and lack of response to grievance
route.reason: The complaint is about an unauthorized transaction in a bank account, which falls directly under the RBI-Integrated Ombudsman Scheme for banking services.
queries: how to file complaint against HDFC Bank with banking ombudsman

steps.name: HDFC Bank Internal Grievance Redressal
steps.channel: HDFC Bank App or NetBanking (Menu > 'Raise Dispute & Report Fraud')
steps.when_to_use: For reporting unauthorized transactions or disputes; the bank is expected to resolve issues through its internal machinery.

steps.name: Reserve Bank of India (Integrated Ombudsman Scheme)
steps.when_to_use: If the bank fails to credit the unauthorized transaction within 10 working days or fails to resolve the grievance after exhausting the bank's internal mechanism.
steps.source: RBI (Commercial Banks - Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025, Para 72

steps.name: Consumer Commission
steps.channel: District or State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
steps.when_to_use: If the grievance remains unresolved after exhausting internal bank remedies and regulatory intervention.

notes: removed link https://cms.rbi.org.in/ from “Reserve Bank of India (Integrated Ombudsman Scheme)”: not an official link found in the sources
rows.note: Since you have already waited 35 days, you have effectively exhausted the bank's internal grievance mechanism. You should proceed directly to the RBI Ombudsman via the CMS portal. Per Clause [C2], the bank was required to credit the unauthorized transaction within 10 working days.

route.domain_free_text: Health insurance claim rejection due to alleged pre-existing disease
route.reason: The complaint is about a health insurance claim rejection, which falls directly under the insurance playbook.

steps.name: Star Health Grievance Redressal
steps.channel: Customer Care Helpline: 044 6900 6900; Email: info@starhealth.in; Visit the designated Grievance Officer at your nearest Star Health branch.
steps.when_to_use: For initial complaints regarding claim rejection.

steps.name: Insurance Ombudsman
steps.channel: Refer to the Office of Insurance Ombudsman (details available via IRDAI).
steps.when_to_use: If the grievance is not addressed within the time set out in the source or not resolved to your satisfaction.

steps.name: National Consumer Helpline
steps.when_to_use: If the dispute remains unresolved through company and regulatory channels.

route.domain_free_text: telecom - unauthorized plan activation and billing dispute
route.reason: The complaint is about a mobile service provider (Jio) and an unauthorized billing issue, which falls directly under the telecom playbook.

steps.name: Reliance Jio Customer Care
steps.channel: Call 198 (from Jio) or 1800 889 9999 (from non-Jio). Obtain a complaint reference number (docket number).
steps.when_to_use: Initial complaint for billing dispute or unauthorized plan activation.

steps.name: Appellate Authority, Reliance Jio
steps.channel: Submit a written application to the Appellate Authority including the complaint reference number, original complaint, and operator's response.
steps.when_to_use: If the complaint remains unresolved after the time set out in the source or you are dissatisfied with the resolution provided by customer care.
